source_role: page-by-page checklist for the first real full-text numeric extraction pass on Nb3Ge

steps.capture_goal: confirm exact Tc statement, page context, and sample identity

steps.open_target: full article tables or sections with phonon-spectrum moments
steps.capture_goal: find row-specific phonon proxy value for Nb3Ge and name the proxy explicitly

steps.open_target: full article sections, tables, or figures with alpha^2F(omega) or explicit lambda values
steps.capture_goal: find a row-specific or explicit Nb3Ge lambda value

steps.source_title_or_doi: family convention unless explicit row source appears
steps.open_target: full text only if an explicit mu_star statement appears during the same pass
steps.capture_goal: either capture a row-specific value or document that only a family convention is available
checklist: record source_title_or_doi or family convention note

stopping_rule: If any step yields only tertiary or synthesis-level text, mark the step unresolved and do not promote it into a benchmark row capture.
claim_boundary: This checklist is an extraction aid only. Completion of the checklist still requires topic-level compatibility review before any row patch.
